title: Moderated mediation model of the association between problematic smartphone use and dry eye disease within Moroccan adolescents.
authors: Bouazza S, Abbouyi S, Zarrouq B.
figures: Diagram illustrating the three central components of the mesolimbic brain circuit involved in behavioral addictions.

Moderated mediation model with Problematic Smartphone Use (PSU) (predictor), Sleep Disturbance (SD) (mediator), physical activity duration (moderator) and Dry Eye Disease (DED) (outcome). ( a ) link between PSU and SD; ( b ) link between SD and DED; ( c ’), link between PSU and DED (direct effect).
Moderating effect of physical activity duration on the connection between problematic smartphone use and dry eye questionnaire DEQ-5.
